model.identity_note: Stock checkpoint: 88 files / 510,313,353,565 bytes / 48 safetensors shards; quant_method fp8 (block 32x32, ue8m0) with expert_dtype fp4 (routed experts and MTP already MXFP4), FP8 Engram tables, BF16 embeddings/head/vision. Revision df42c109 differs only in encoding/*.py; all shards and config.json are byte-identical.

runtime.image_note: No public image is published. Build with runtime/deepseek-v41-gb10/build-image.sh from vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-8a728663c1c3eeace834a95f5654fa653cc1998c + vllm-project/vllm dsv41-feat@e47aa780bccf59f59dfa2cbb18e17a10b4fe69ba + FlashInfer 07869c61ba581e6d6b8ad8d142f4a6c89b707cc1 (0.7.0rc1), then pin IMAGE_ID in the env file.
runtime.nccl: SparkRing patched NCCL 2.30.7 (libnccl.so.2 from any published SparkRing image) bind-mounted from the host and preloaded (LD_PRELOAD + VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH)

engram.note: Engram rows are read from shards 47/48 on the rank's local NVMe at serve time and staged before the forward; every rank needs its own complete local copy of the checkpoint.
engram.column_assignment: balanced: rank r owns hash columns c with c % 4 == r (two bigram, two trigram, two four-gram heads); the all-gather is permuted back to column order
engram.packed_shards: runtime/deepseek-v41-gb10/tools/pack_engram_rows.py --tp 4 --rank <r> --balanced builds engram-l1/l14-packed.bin (+ .json manifest) under the cache mount: sparse 101 GB files, ~48 GB allocated per rank, 264 B per row (weight + scale adjacent), one pread per row; ~9 min per rank
engram.why: Strided assignment distributes bigram, trigram and four-gram hash columns evenly across ranks. Packed rows place weights and scales together, permitting one read per row. This limits rank imbalance and NVMe reads before the collective; measured comparisons are in evidence.benchmark.

cuda_graphs.capture_sizes: For speculative-token count k and sequence counts n=1..max_num_seqs, capture draft batches k*n and verification batches (k+1)*n.

serving.sizing_note: The configured request limit is 1,048,576 tokens. With the Engram tables on NVMe a rank loads 78.79 GiB text-only or 81.6 GiB with the DSpark draft layers and vision encoder; consumed memory at startup 85.71 GiB. At gpu_memory_utilization 0.83 and a 430,080-token limit the KV pool measured 10.94 GiB = 2,182,642 tokens (5.07x 430K) with 13-15 GiB MemAvailable per rank while serving; 0.85 gave 3,085,606 tokens but only 7-9 GiB MemAvailable, and the recorded profile keeps the headroom. block-size 128 is required (an auto-picked 64 fails KV initialization); the patched backends keep 64-state pages internally. max-num-seqs 16 was probed at c=16 (285 tok/s prompt-set aggregate, 13-15 GiB free at 0.80) and is a valid admission option; 8 is the soaked value.

memory_profiler.note: vLLM's estimate reserved 1.52 GiB for CUDA graphs that measured 0.54 GiB; with the estimate off the KV pool gains the difference.

evidence.conditions: Four directly cabled GB10 DGX Sparks (0-1-2-3-0 cycle, two RoCE devices per rank, MTU 9000), SparkRing patched NCCL 2.30.7, image sha256:af86a3d2bb0d267faa7f31777cdbe855addc1348f0b9f8323016ebf17d3dae3c and checkpoint dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277 on each rank's NVMe. The throughput matrix used a 300,000-token limit, gpu_memory_utilization=0.80, probabilistic draft sampling and 32 Engram threads. Memory sizing also measured a 430,080-token limit with utilization 0.83, greedy draft sampling, 64 threads and graph-profiler estimation disabled. The benchmark record identifies the settings for each parameter comparison and soak. Throughput requests used temperature 0, thinking disabled and one batch per concurrency level; cold prefill used unique prompts and one-token replies.
evidence.result: The throughput matrix measured mean per-stream decode of 56.2 tok/s at one request and 31.4 tok/s at six concurrent requests; corresponding aggregate throughput was 49.8 and 159.9 tok/s. Cold prefill measured 1,376-1,574 tok/s across 2,950-93,335 prompt tokens. Needle retrieval passed at 131K and 262K; vision and tool checks passed 7/7. An eight-stream, 20-minute soak completed 648 requests with zero failures or hangs. At the 430,080-token limit and memory utilization 0.83, the measured KV pool was 2,182,642 tokens with 13-15 GiB MemAvailable per rank. Per-cell measurements, alternate settings and the 400K retrieval test are retained in evidence.benchmark.
evidence.conclusion: The recorded four-rank settings are live-benchmarked on a locally built image. There is no published image digest to replay, so the profile is implemented, not qualified.
limitations: No public image; every operator builds their own and pins IMAGE_ID.
Seven runtime patches are bind-mounted over the pinned image; runtime/deepseek-v41-gb10/README.md identifies their purposes and sources.
Adaptive verification is off: padded speculative batches can hang the SM120 sparse-MLA kernel (flashinfer #5015).
One benchmark batch per cell; no repeated-run confidence interval. Output quality beyond needle recall and the end-to-end checks was not evaluated.
vLLM logs a Duplicate NCCL runtime warning (patched vs pip 2.30.7, path assert); the patched library is the one mapped and loaded by PyNccl.
The linked measurements used limits through 430,080 tokens; they do not measure the 1,048,576-token default.
